tasks.title: BUG-USER: API error 401 on /login: GET /api/auth/me → {"detail":"Invalid token"}
tasks.description: Already fixed in commit 380178b — auth.py now returns 'Invalid or expired session' instead of 'Invalid token'. Frontend suppresses expected 401s on auth endpoints.

tasks.title: SEC: SSE _running_tasks leaks cross-tenant task progress
tasks.description: pipeline.py:1438 — when SSE client connects without video_id, it iterates ALL _running_tasks (line 51) which is a global dict keyed by video_id only, with NO tenant_id scoping. An authenticated user from tenant A can see task progress from tenant B. Fix: key _running_tasks by (tenant_id, video_id) tuple, or filter by tenant_id before yielding.

tasks.title: SEC: HTML injection in email templates via display_name
tasks.description: email_service.py:59,110 — user display_name is f-string interpolated directly into HTML email body without html.escape(). Attacker can register with display_name='<script>alert(1)</script>' and inject HTML/JS into welcome and trial warning emails. Fix: import html; use html.escape(display_name) in all send_* functions. Also affects plan/amount_display in send_billing_receipt (line 96-97).

tasks.title: SEC: Key validation leaks exception details + Gemini key in URL
tasks.description: Two issues: (1) vault.py:356 and settings.py:231 — raw str(e) returned to client, leaking internal paths/library versions. Fix: return generic 'Validation error' message. (2) vault.py:326 — Gemini API key sent as URL query param (?key=VALUE), gets logged in access logs. Fix: use x-goog-api-key header instead.
